messages:
Mara: quick sync — we need clear pilot scope for Optimize: batching, prefix cache, quant profiles, eval-triggered alerts. Customers want concrete acceptance criteria.

Josh: agreed. what's the smallest set that gives customer value?

Kaori: minimal pilot: route-aware batcher with per-route latency budgets, prefix KV cache with ttl & opt-out, two quant profiles, basic eval webhook.

Sam: add safe rollout: percent canary + auto-fallback to pinned variants on regressions.

Liz: AcmeHealth/NovaSearch asked for a one-pager: latency bands, token-cost delta, and an ops playbook.

Josh: acceptance metrics: p50/p95/p99 by route, token-per-request delta, eval quality delta <=1%.

Mara: swimlanes: Product=acceptance/comms, Eng-runtime=batcher/cache/quant hooks, Eng-ML=profiles+evals, Eng-Ops=canary+telemetry, Solutions=pilot onboarding.

Kaori: timeline: batcher+canary by sprint2 end, cache+quant sprint3, eval-alerting+playbook sprint4.

Josh: small quant schema example:
```yaml
id: q-llama2-13b-8bit
model_family: llama2-13b
bits: 8
expected_latency_pct: -20
expected_cost_pct: -40
fallback_chain: [llama2-13b-8bit, llama2-13b-fp16]
```

Sam: ops note: need ownership split for eval alerts — Eng-ML builds detectors, Eng-Ops runs delivery. ops-bot: created #optimize-eval-alerts and webhook.

Mara: actions: Josh=PR batcher MVP by Fri, Kaori=quant profiles+evals next Wed, Liz=customer 1-pager sprint2 end, Sam=open infra ticket for 2-GPU dev pool. I'll own acceptance rubric.

Liz: can Product Marketing join next sync for beta messaging?

Mara: yes — invite them.

Josh: engineering caveat: adaptive batch window tied to route budget to avoid tail spikes.

Kaori: add console toggle to disable cache per-route for privacy-sensitive tenants.

Mara: agreed. defaults for eval thresholds but allow per-customer overrides to reduce noise.

Sam: I'll create swimlane cards and assign owners.

Mara: thanks — follow-ups on the board. :thumbsup:
